plan.objective: Test the historical return leader EMA55: seven factors and two initial-stop sizing methods. Rank only by return; report win/loss and drawdown descriptively, with no eligibility gates.
plan.selection: Run the first year for all 37 fixed single-factor versions. Within each factor include baseline, pick maximum first-year return; exact tie prefers baseline then ID. Lock the winners before any later-period run.
plan.combination_rule: Construct exactly three combinations using only the locked first-year factor winners. Evaluate their first year, rank all 40 by first-year return and lock a single choice before later periods. Do not replace that choice with later/full winner. Duplicate parameter sets are retained and disclosed; no further search.
execution: Unchanged cached Binance spot ETH/USDT 15m data, engine v4, 650 warmup, no fees/slippage/leverage, 100% current equity. Single position, no additions.

Center EMA(hl2,N); W=EMA(high-low,M), NOT ATR. Close crosses center +/- trigger*W; directional close-to-center distance <= chase*W. Zero chase means no distance restriction. Signal close only, fill next open; no extra next-open chase check.
Entry filters do not suppress the raw opposite exit. Same-side entry signals cannot reset a live stop. No fixed take-profit.

Initial percent stop uses actual fill. Width stop sets percent=100*multiple*signal_W/signal_close, then engine applies this percent to actual fill. Width frozen at decision, no future-volatility widening.
Initial stop is active on the entry candle. Profit protection ratchets it in the profitable direction, never loosens it. Either initial/profit stop or raw opposite signal can exit.

Peak favorable high/low is updated after each close; tightened protection applies next bar. Gaps through an active stop fill at actual open. The retained-profit percentage is not a guaranteed execution price.
Four later quarters start/end flat and compound for the following-year report. Full two-year backtest is continuous. These two conventions need not have identical transactions at boundaries.
plan.limit: 37 single-factor configurations plus exactly 3 predeclared first-year-selected combinations, six periods each = 240 simulations. 40 full-period project records reproduce these, not new research trials. No expansion after results.
plan.caveat: Both years already inspected repeatedly; chronological selection here checks transfer within reused history, not untouched out-of-sample. No claim that the best tested value is a long-term global optimum.
